identity.name: Swatch Irony Swiss-Made 007
identity.one_liner: The Swatch Irony line is the affordable end of Swatch's Swiss-made offering — ETA quartz in a steel case for less than the cost of a dinner.

narrative.story: The Irony line is Swatch's answer to the question "what if a plastic Swatch was stainless steel and on a leather strap?" — a $180 Swiss-made quartz watch in a 43mm steel case. The Irony is the watch a Bangkok secondary-school student is most likely to own before they upgrade to a Tissot. Swatch sells the Irony across roughly 40 reference families, of which the 007 is the most-cited because of the obvious name echo with Bond — a deliberate marketing coincidence the brand has not leaned into, but the watch world has.
narrative.collector_notes: The Irony 007's reference number is YSS1007. The 007 has no formal Bond association. The case is 43mm, which is large for a $180 quartz. The leather strap is interchangeable with any standard 21mm Swatch Irony strap.
